films.title: Built a House inside BED in Minecraft

second_pass_observations.speech_function: Explicit revenge and freeloading motive, announce shrink trick and sneak plan. Whisper name sounds Boo, onscreen captions show Buu.

second_pass_observations.speech_function: Conversation names each room/object as characters build and choose which household items to take.

second_pass_observations.visual: Exterior farm raid, indoor field prepared with dirt/water/torches, crops grow and are harvested
second_pass_observations.speech_function: A practical unmet need (food) leads to foraging, then established indoor farming system.

second_pass_observations.visual: Fire/heat ice/fan preps, arrow turret or dispensers installed and wired to levers, green reflector machinery, exterior observation window, black NIGHT title card
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Actors explicitly anticipate fire and explosions, announce the role of each defense before attack starts.

second_pass_observations.speech_function: Earlier stolen-savings grievance becomes recoverable objective; theft retrieval links beginning to last conflict.

second_pass_observations.speech_function: Threat previously forecast is realized; names action consequences and rapid fix.

films.title: Minecraft, But Item Drops Are Multiplied Every Time!!

second_pass_observations.visual: Village farm wheat and seeds, sand/wood, green multiplying tool held in POV, hotbar/inventory rapidly fills
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Character demonstrates extra block-item drops and immediate utility with visible measurable results.

second_pass_observations.visual: Found gold around lava portal, desert pyramid entry, pressure plate with TNT trap, loot and repeated TNT stacks
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Gold/TNT explosion hazards become resource opportunity; craft/disarm in response to risk.

second_pass_observations.visual: Iron crafts, zombie combat, use duplicated TNT behind protective obsidian barrier to excavate enormous lava cave, then diamond ore
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Resources amplify exploration speed but do not remove monster and lava risk.

second_pass_observations.visual: Diamond piles explode across ground; armor, swords and golden apples crafted; special gear visibly changes player inventory and player appearance
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Explicit equipment payoff, increasing resource quantities turn into survivability and next quest preparation.

second_pass_observations.visual: Huge Nether portal built; Nether fortress, flames, blazes and Enderman confront heroes, individual Blaze Rod/Ender Pearl are collected
second_pass_observations.speech_function: A non-block enemy drop introduces obstacle: special tool seems limited to blocks, so they must gather initial rod/pearl.

second_pass_observations.visual: CRITICAL SECOND-PASS CORRECTION: player puts a Blaze Rod and Ender Pearl into a chest and then exploits duplication of the CHEST BLOCK with contents; Eye of Ender crafting and End portal
second_pass_observations.speech_function: The protagonists creatively route around tool constraint with chest-as-container workaround, not just farming all non-block drops normally.

second_pass_observations.visual: The End boss bar, mass iron golem creation, dragon breath damages golems, then obsidian island platform and stacks of TNT around dragon landing pit
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Expensive army fails under dragon breath; switch tactics to repeated TNT attacks.

second_pass_observations.visual: Several TNT volleys and health bar decline, dragon beaten, dragon egg touched/vanishes, end-card shows fixed 2D mascots and channel CTA
second_pass_observations.speech_function: Multiple attempts needed to win, then small epilogue and CTA; egg exact game rules unverified.

films.corrected_vs_previous: The multiplier's direct target appears to be blocks but 12:20-12:50 shows a creative chest-containing-items duplication workaround to obtain additional Ender Pearls and Blaze Rods. Claim that all non-block items simply cannot be duplicated was incomplete.

common_verified_story_patterns: Open by demonstrating or stating an unmistakable rule/grievance in under a minute.
Keep character dialogue causal with contrasting expectations; follow original visual inventory or room state.
Use preparatory steps that pay off in final conflict: security against fire/rockets, resource doubling against dragon, not arbitrary unrelated challenges.
Craft content around different driving systems, not uniform Maizen 7 challenge chapters.
Display game state and item counts when resource logic matters; transition between first-person HUD and third-person planned character reaction.
End with a separate 2D brand/editorial package. Do not copy Maizen's protected graphics, skins, voices, assets.

cinefactory_handoffs.research: Keep film-specific 30s visual and source-sound receipts with hash, coverage and uncertainties; repeat same process on every new competitor film; do not substitute ASR for sound QC.
cinefactory_handoffs.script_room: MAI01 waterfall can use planted safety mechanisms paying off during later flood, original two-character tension, and a physical workaround to obstacle (inspired by container rule logic, without copying shots or Buu story).
cinefactory_handoffs.production_design: Connected giant/small scale world, workshop layout, inventory and equipment behavior must be designed before shots.
cinefactory_handoffs.technical_direction: Build testable implementations of camera, character control, mechanics, custom props and voxel set; Blender-authoring/game-staging/hybrid remain candidates, no exact rival code inference.
cinefactory_handoffs.audio_editorial: Two original authorized English voices, inspect sound effect synchrony/music rights and do separate independent full-source native audio listening before final gate, not use AudioSet or Whisper to certify them.
cinefactory_handoffs.qc: Require every <=30sec complete native moving-picture and original audio notes and a distinct independent auditor signoff for G02 before method-specific production stage; company draft packet v243 remains DRAFT.
